values.note: 30-amp $28 a night ($168 week, $495 month, $2,550 season), 50-amp $30 ($182 week, $525 month, $2,700 season). One rate for everyone (no resident split posted). Reserving takes a $32 non-refundable card deposit: $30 toward the stay plus a $2 reservation fee. Card fees 2.65% (min $3).

fees.source: https://finnroadpark.com/rates-%26-reservations (camping rates table; '$30.00 non-refundable deposit') + https://finnroadpark.com/park-rules ('A $32.00 nonrefundable deposit ... ($30.00 to go towards the camping fee plus a $2.00 reservation fee)') + https://finnroadpark.com/faqs (card fees), read 2026-10-22 (site copyright 2026; the rates are not dated)

season.source: https://finnroadpark.com/ ('open for camping May 1 - October 31') + https://finnroadpark.com/rates-%26-reservations ('Seasonally ... May 1 - October 31'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://finnroadpark.com/ ('full-hookup cement padded RV sites with water, sewer, and electric (30 or 50 AMP) hookups') + https://finnroadpark.com/faqs ('Due to the location of the shared water spigots in the park, it is recommended you have 50 ft of water hose or more'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 57 back-in sites on cement pads about 16 ft wide; the layout page gives each pad's length (about 13 to 64 ft, most 45-57 ft, plus grass behind). Water spigots are shared between sites: bring 50 ft of hose. No tent camping.

sites.source: https://finnroadpark.com/layout ('Our sites are back in only'; 'Each site's cement pad is about 16 feet wide'; Site 1-57 pad lengths) + https://finnroadpark.com/faqs ('Finn Road Campground does not accommodate tent campers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Free showers in the modern bathhouse. Dump station (public, $10). Wi-Fi by Sky Web for a fee (from $2.99/day); free hotspot at the pavilion.

facilities.source: https://finnroadpark.com/faqs ('we have showers available to campers to use free of charge'; Wi-Fi plans) + https://finnroadpark.com/amenities%2Fconveniences ('Dump Station 10 public dump station'; 'modern bathhouse'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Call or e-mail the manager, Ellen Lutz (989-992-2920, finnroadpark@gmail.com). 'Reservations are not required but are encouraged. Sites are not guaranteed to walk-on's.' Next year's reservations open October 1; the office is closed November - March. Campers staying a month or longer can rebook the same site and dates on departure. Check-in 1-8 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Hampton Township-owned campground near Saginaw Bay at the township's public boat launch (walleye fishing), Essexville; pavilion, playground and nature trails. Nightly stays plus monthly and seasonal. --Claude
summary: Township campground's own site (finnroadpark.com): 30-amp $28 / 50-amp $30 a night (matches; undated, site copyright 2026), $2 reservation fee inside a $32 deposit, no resident split; season May 1 - Oct 31; 57 back-in full-hookup sites on cement pads (shared water spigots), free showers, $10 dump, paid Wi-Fi; phone/e-mail reservations with walk-ins when space allows. Confirmed derived hookups/count/season/dump; added no pull-through, showers, wifi, reservation fee, booking details. Note cleaned: dropped the stale '~$26-27/night' and text the fields hold.
